snippet.title: Brokensides | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist On Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4906730/Brokensides/

You play as Yorunna Parva, a violent sea bunny who is finally free from imprisonment after committing a Cardinal Crime.
Yorunna can explore and break her enemies like glass with Beat 'Em Up elements...


Trailer Music:
Broken Eyes (Instrumental) - Jens Vide
